hooks.text: An astronaut ruined NASA's first lunar color camera within minutes.
NASA sent a color camera to the Moon, then broke it.
One mistake killed NASA's first live color Moon broadcast.

title: How a Hammer Failed to Save NASA's First Color Moon TV
description: During Apollo 12 in 1969, NASA brought its first live color TV camera to the Moon. When astronaut Alan Bean accidentally pointed it at the Sun, he tried fixing the ruined broadcast with a hammer.
